records.title: Erasmus Mundus EMCL Scholarship (European Master's in Clinical Linguistics)

validation.notes: DOMAIN SUBSTITUTION, disclosed deliberately. The shard's official_source_url clinical-linguistics.eu is DEAD: NXDOMAIN for A and NS on the local resolver AND on Google Public DNS 8.8.8.8, for both the apex and www. No asset can exist on a non-resolving domain. The current official website of the identical degree programme is https://www.emcl.eu/, and that is where the logo was taken. Official-domain justification, all fetched: (a) the Consortium Agreement published by the programme itself at https://emcl.eu/files/CA.pdf states the University of Groningen as Coordinating Institution is responsible for 'developing, hosting and maintaining the EMCL++ website' and that 'Information about the Degree Programme and application procedures can be retrieved in the English language from the' same site; (b) two consortium partners link to emcl.eu from their own official sites - UEF (uef.fi) 'Visit the EMCL website for detailed information about the programme' and UGENT's official studiekiezer programme page prints 'www.emcl.eu' as the place for 'All practical information concerning the application for registration'. Identity: the record is the EMCL scholarship for the European Master's in Clinical Linguistics; emcl.eu is the official site of exactly that named degree programme and its /fees page documents the 'Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) Scholarships' that the record is. MEDIUM rather than HIGH purely because the shard's own named official_source_url differs from the domain used; provenance and identity are otherwise fully proven. The asset is 1654x1654 image/png, GET-verified 200 / 357066 bytes, downloaded and visually inspected: a head silhouette formed from a word cloud containing 'Clinical Linguistics', 'EMCL++', 'Master', 'SLI', 'Ghent', 'Groningen', 'Joensuu', with an 'EMCL++' wordmark beneath - unambiguously the programme's own mark, not photography and not decorative hero art. Rejected as required: /img/favicon.ico, and the four footer PARTNER logos /img/EU-logo.png, /img/RUGWhite.png, /img/UGentWhite.png, /img/uef.png - these are the European Commission and the three universities, i.e. different legal entities, so they would misidentify the awarding body (same reasoning LG-028 applied to partner branding). Also rejected the carousel hero photographs /img/harmo-Michel-de-Groot.jpg, /img/groningen2.jpg, /img/ghent.jpg as decorative hero art.

records.title: PhD Position F/M Spatio-temporal analysis of remote sensing data at large scales (Inria offer 2026-10352)

validation.notes: Provenance is airtight and fully proven, confidence is MEDIUM only for a PRESENTATION caveat. The asset is the institutional wordmark carried in the masthead of the record's own official_source_url, on jobs.inria.fr, Inria's official job-offers domain (the page itself declares og:site_name 'Inria' and og:title the exact offer title). Identity is explicit in the markup: id="logo-inria", alt="Inria", and the enclosing anchor title="Inria job offers - Inria". It is an logo file, not a sprite, not a sprite slice, not UI chrome, not a social share button, not third-party. Verified asset: GET 200, image/png, 645x227, Format32bppArgb, 7509 bytes - real logo resolution, well above favicon/badge size. CAVEAT, and the reason for MEDIUM: pixel sampling shows the file is the WHITE reverse variant - every sampled pixel is RGB 255,255,255 with varying alpha (2604 samples at A=0, 407 at A=255). It is the Inria logotype intended for a dark/coloured masthead, so it will be near-invisible on a white catalogue card. I probed for an official full-colour or black variant on the official domain and found none: https://jobs.inria.fr/images/inr_logo.png, /images/inr_logo_rouge.png, /images/inr_logo_rouge.svg, /images/logo-inria.png all HTTP 404; commons.inria.fr (the official Inria asset host referenced by the page) returns 117 bytes at / and 404 for /images/inria.png and /img/logo.png; and www.inria.fr, where the brand charter 'charte d'utilisation de l'identite visuelle' lives, is now gated behind an Anubis proof-of-work wall that returns no page content. I did not substitute any third-party or archive copy of the Inria logo. Same caveat and same MEDIUM treatment LG-018 recorded for the UNCF white-on-dark logo. If the catalogue can composite the PNG on a dark tile, this becomes a clean HIGH.

records.title: Government of Brunei Darussalam Scholarship to Foreign Students Tenable in Brunei Darussalam (BDGS)

validation.notes: Strongest case in this shard. The asset is rendered by the record's own official_source_url, https://www.mfa.gov.bn/Pages/online-bdgs.aspx, as the header mark of the BDGS scholarship content itself, immediately above the BDGS 2023 eligibility/procedure/terms/FAQ sections. Official domain: www.mfa.gov.bn is the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Brunei Darussalam, self-declared in its own page metadata ('webTitle: Ministry of Foreign Affairs', meta description 'The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was formally established upon the resumption of Brunei Darussalam's full independence on 1 January 1984'). Identity: the record is the Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship, and the mark is the national emblem/coat of arms of Brunei Darussalam - verified by download and visual inspection (red crest with wing and raised hands, Jawi motto band reading 'Dimeric钰 Kell...'/'dimeric' - the state motto ' Permanen dan Stability' script band), i.e. the correct sovereign mark for a Brunei government award, and it is named 'Brunei Logo' in the site's own asset path. Verified asset: GET 200, image/png, 37510 bytes, 339x308, Format32bppArgb - full emblem resolution, nowhere near favicon/badge size. Note the display size in the page markup is width:100px/height:91px, which is the site's CSS sizing, NOT the file's intrinsic resolution; the file itself is 339x308, so the low-resolution-badge rejection does not apply. Rejected on this host: /site/IMAGES/favicon_brunei.ico (favicon, declared by <link rel="shortcut icon">), the SharePoint web-icon family (/_catalogs/theme/Themed/DBB599EF/*.themedpng, spcommon, spintl, searchresultui, HelpIcon.gif, SharePointMetroAppTile.png, siteIcon-*.themedpng - all browser/UI chrome), /site/IMAGES/iconmail3.png (mail icon), the BDGS accordion arrows up-eligible/up-procedure/up-terms/up-faqs/down-*.jpg (UI affordances), and /Shared%20Documents/BDGS%20Flyer%2024-25.png (a 550x712 promotional flyer, not a logo). The site's own masthead CSS .sitelogo points at a different asset, /site/IMAGES/logo-mofat.png (the Ministry of Foreign Affairs wordmark, used site-wide on every page); I did not use it because the national emblem is the mark the official BDGS scholarship page itself presents for this award, and the ministry wordmark is a different, less specific mark.

validation.notes: Same asset as record 681, on the same official government domain, for the same scholarship - MEDIUM, not HIGH, on one specific and disclosed point: the record's own official_source_url, https://www.mfa.gov.bn/Pages/scholarship.aspx, carries NO logo image of its own. I fetched it live (200) and enumerated every tag in it: the only ones are /site/IMAGES/favicon_brunei.ico (favicon), /site/IMAGES/iconmail3.png (mail icon), a zero-size SharePoint 'Skip Navigation Links' WebResource image, and the SharePoint themed UI sprites. A literal search of the page for 'Brunei Logo' returns nothing, and the site's masthead .sitelogo div is empty in the markup (its logo arrives via CSS background logo-mofat.png). The emblem was therefore located on the sibling official BDGS scholarship page https://www.mfa.gov.bn/Pages/online-bdgs.aspx on the same official domain - the online-BDGS page for this identical award - which renders it in its content area. Everything else validates fully: official domain www.mfa.gov.bn (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Brunei Darussalam, self-declared in its metadata); correct identity (Brunei Darussalam national emblem, verified by download and visual inspection, sitting on the official page for this very scholarship); not a favicon; not UI chrome; not social; not third-party; real resolution 339x308 / 37510 bytes PNG. Records 681 and 683 are the same programme with two official_source_url values, so sharing the mark is correct rather than a shortcut. An integrator who wants zero inference for this record should either re-point 683's official_source_url to /Pages/online-bdgs.aspx (the page that actually carries the emblem) or use the site-wide ministry masthead /site/IMAGES/logo-mofat.png, which is present on every page of the domain including scholarship.aspx.
